summary.en: Venezuelan forces bombed an ELN camp in Apure, killing at least 19 combatants, and a separate bomb attack in western Colombia killed four civilians. President De la Espriella is expanding militarization along the Venezuelan border as the ultra-right government moves the army onto the streets. Cuts to the human-rights court threaten its ability to address abuses. Former M‑19 leader Antonio Navarro Wolff, architect of the 1991 constitution, died. The conflict recorded 225 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Venezuelanske styrker bombet en ELN-leir i Apure, og drepte minst 19 kampere, og et separat bombeangrep i vestlige Colombia drepte fire sivile. President De la Espriella utvider militariseringen langs den venezuelanske grensen mens den ultra-høyre regjeringen flytter hæren ut på gatene. Kutt i menneskerettighetsdomstolen truer dens evne til å behandle overgrep. Den tidligere M‑19‑lederen Antonio Navarro Wolff, arkitekten bak grunnloven fra 1991, er død. Konflikten registrerte 225 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Colombian conflict
background.extract: The Colombian conflict began on May 27, 1964, and is a low-intensity asymmetric war between the government of Colombia, paramilitary groups, crime syndicates, and far-left guerrilla groups engaged in armed factional hostilities to increase their influence in Colombian territory. Some of the most important international contributors to the Colombian conflict include multinational corporations, the United States, Cuba, and the drug trafficking industry.
